body:
This actually struck me as a feature that was missing in the original spring bone, since I wanted to use it to implement wind... so I am happy to see this added as a feature.

> Maybe we could also add a randomizer to set random force for each joint (like fractal field) but we should do that in another PR or proposal as a follow up, since we need to be careful how we define the parameters

I think this is a bit overkill. I'd rather see people who need this can add randomness to the per-joint gravity in a script, and if it affects people who need better performance, then we can add randomness to the engine in a future version. I just don't think we're going to guess exactly what users need in advance.

Is the unit of m/s correct? It should probably match gravity. Is there an overall gravity strength setting?
Agreed with @lyuma that this is going to be needed to implement features like wind.👍
